After landing on a private jet with his family in Miami, Florida , on Wednesday morning, the far-right senator published the claim in a letter – even though his own party has recognised the legitimate victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva , as have all of Brazil’s institutions, and international observers who monitored and endorsed the… Publicado también por: The New York Times - World, The Guardian - World, Euronews, NPR - World. item.title: What’s next for Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro after election defeat?
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro's clandestine escape to the United States bewildered Brazil and triggered a frantic search for his whereabouts. The Supreme Court had ordered the son of jailed ex-leader Jair Bolsonaro to forfeit his passports after his electoral loss on Sunday, amid fears he would leave the country due to ongoing investigations against him. But the defeated right-wing presidential candidate failed to hand them in, choosing instead to flee to the US via Argentina and Ecuador. FRANCE 24's Tim Vickery reports from Rio de Janeiro. Publicado también por: BBC News - World, France 24 - English, The Hindu - International, The New York Times - World, The Jerusalem Post - International, Euronews. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Historic gains for Arab-majority parties in Israeli election
item.description: Two Arab-majority parties are set to win a historic 19 seats in total, amid a record turnout at the polls in Israel on Tuesday. Voters from the community, descendants of Palestinians who stayed after Israel's creation and who make up around 20 percent of the population, have been enraged by the Netanyahu government's ultra-nationalist Jewish vision for the country and the Palestinian territories. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: España: accidente ferroviario deja varios muertos y heridos
item.description: 🇪🇸 Un tren de alta velocidad embistió por detrás a otro convoy detenido a la altura de Urda (Toledo), al sur de Madrid. El Gobierno de España apunta a un error humano, después de un fallo reportado en el sistema de señalización automático. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Tras una histórica elección, los partidos árabes se abren a una alianza anti-Netanyahu en Israel
item.description: A falta de que se complete el recuento definitivo, los ciudadanos palestinos de Israel se encaminan a obtener un número récord de escaños en el Parlamento, erigiéndose como una fuerza decisiva para la formación de un gobierno. Mientras esos partidos se han mostrado dispuestos a colaborar para desbancar a Benjamin Netanyahu, los líderes de la oposición judía enfrentan el dilema de acceder a una cooperación que, en campaña, prometieron no llevar a cabo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
